SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  p.category,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales

JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, p.category
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, p.category;

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  p.category,
  COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) as gross_sales,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as total_returns,
  COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND d.fiscal_period = 8
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, p.category
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, p.category;

WITH sales_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    p.category,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, p.category
)
SELECT 
  category,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) as net_sales_fy2025_26,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) as net_sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) - 
          MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END)) / 
         MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) * 100, 2) as growth_pct
FROM sales_by_category
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;
